Name: Pâtisserie Sadaharu Aoki Paris
Hours: Shop 11:00–20:00; salon about 11:00–17:30 (last order 17:00); irregular closures; hours may change without notice
Address (JA): 東京都千代田区丸の内3-4-1 新国際ビル1F
Notes: Benchmark Japanese-French crossover: matcha éclair, matcha mille-feuille, black sesame macarons, "Bamboo" matcha opera. Update: Official site shows notices of changed salon hours (Marunouchi, Sep 2026) and Midtown closure days (Oct 2026); check before going.

Name: Pâtisserie ease
Hours: 11:00–18:00 (eat-in last order 17:00); closed Wednesdays
Address (JA): 東京都中央区日本橋兜町9-1
Notes: France-trained chef; Japanese herbs with fruit (e.g., shiso-mango mousse). 7-seat counter for plated desserts plus takeaway cakes. Update: The shop is in Kabutocho (Nihonbashi), 3 min from Kayabacho Station; Time Out lists it as 7 counter seats.

Name: Pâtisserie Asako Iwayanagi
Hours: 11:00–18:00; closed Mondays and Tuesdays (open on public holidays per one source)
Address (JA): 東京都世田谷区等々力4-4-5
Notes: Famous for parfaits of up to 20 components (kinako gelato, green-tea mochi) plus a petits gâteaux case. Parfaits usually need a reservation.

Name: Pâtisserie Ryoura
Hours: 12:00–17:00; closed Tuesdays and Wednesdays plus irregular closures
Address (JA): 東京都世田谷区用賀4-29-5 グリーンヒルズ用賀ST 1F
Notes: Critically loved neighborhood shop; classic French cakes with seasonal Japanese fruit. Worth the suburban trip. Update: Official hours are 12:00–17:00; older articles say 11:00–19:00.

Name: 365日
Address (JA): 東京都渋谷区富ヶ谷1-2-8
Notes: Influential bakery built on domestic ingredients; matcha-citrus brioche, kinako cream buns. Pair with Tomigaya coffee. Update: Located in Tomigaya, about 1–2 min from Yoyogi-Hachiman Station.

Name: BOUL'ANGE
Hours: 11:00–20:00 (sources conflict; 2021 opening said 10:00–21:00)
Address (JA): 東京都渋谷区道玄坂1-12-1 渋谷マークシティ 1F
Notes: Easy croissant stop: yuzu croissants plus seasonal sakura and chestnut editions.

Name: KURAMAE CANNELE
Hours: About 11:00–18:00; closed Mondays (sources conflict: takeout to 19:00 or 20:00; 2F cafe to 18:00)
Address (JA): 東京都台東区蔵前2-1-23 K2B 蔵前第二ビル 1F
Notes: Canelé specialist. Combine with Dandelion Chocolate Kuramae (local green-tea-scented hot chocolate).

Name: Mont St. Clair
Hours: 11:00–18:00; closed Wednesdays plus occasional extra days; salon last order 16:00
Address (JA): 東京都目黒区自由が丘2-22-4
Notes: Hironobu Tsujiguchi's flagship; huge case. Jiyugaoka is a sweets district, good for a half day. Update: The salon (16 seats) closes after 30 Nov 2026 and is expected to reopen around April 2027; the shop stays open.

Name: Pâtisserie Asterisque
Address (JA): ~東京都渋谷区大山町
Notes: France-trained chef; mille-feuille, Mont Blanc, fruit entremets. More classically French. Update: Opened May 2012 on Inokashira-dori, Yoyogi-Uehara (chef Koichi Izumi); described as takeaway only. Search gave no address. Location approximate: pinned near 代々木上原 station until the shop is found.

Name: Am Stram Gram
Address (JA): ~東京都渋谷区恵比寿南一丁目
Notes: Tart specialist with 20+ daily varieties topped with fruit from local farms. Update: Search gave no address. Location approximate: pinned near 恵比寿 station until the shop is found.

Name: Okashiya Ucchi
Address (JA): 東京都渋谷区千駄ヶ谷3-27-9
Notes: Among Tabelog's top-rated Tokyo cake shops (4.19). Tiny, sells out. Style unverified; a wildcard. Update: Shop near Kita-Sando (4 min on foot), owner Yusuke Uchiyama; makes only what it sells that day; the back eat-in space is reservation only. Spelling is おかしやうっちー, not うっちい. Takeout plus reservation-only eat-in (13:00-16:00 slots, max 4 groups a day); address from one English travel site.

Name: Naniwaya Sohonten
Hours: 11:00–19:00 (one source says 10:00–20:00); closed Tuesdays and the 3rd Wednesday, sources vary
Address (JA): 東京都港区麻布十番1-8-14
Notes: Claims to have invented taiyaki (Meiji era); Hokkaido azuki simmered 8 hours. One of Tokyo's big three.

Name: Yanagiya
Hours: 12:30–18:00; closed Sundays and public holidays (one source says Sunday and Monday); often sold out early
Address (JA): 東京都中央区日本橋人形町2-11-3
Notes: Since 1916; anko made by hand each morning; sells out daily. One of Tokyo's big three.

Name: Taiyaki Wakaba
Address (JA): ~東京都新宿区若葉一丁目
Notes: Since 1953; slightly salty anko packed to the tail. One of Tokyo's big three. Update: Founded 1953 (Showa 28); cash only; opposite Yotsuya Ichimochido (四谷1-17-8 area, Wakaba district).

Name: Nezu no Taiyaki
Hours: From 10:00 until sold out (usually around 12:30–14:00); closed Saturdays, Sundays and public holidays; takeout only, cash
Address (JA): 東京都文京区根津1-23-9-104
Notes: Family-run since the 1950s; each one baked in its own iron mold (tennen) for a thin, crisp shell. Often sells out by midday. Update: Closed on weekends and holidays, so plan a weekday visit.

Name: Taiyaki Sharaku
Address (JA): ~東京都台東区浅草三丁目
Notes: Tennen-style single-mold taiyaki, classic red bean. Convenient during Asakusa sightseeing.

Name: Himitsudo
Hours: 10:00–19:00 (Sat/Sun from 09:00), varying by season; closed Mondays, plus Tuesdays from October to June
Address (JA): 東京都台東区谷中3-11-18
Notes: Tokyo's most famous kakigori shop; fluffy ice shaved from natural ice, with house-made seasonal fruit syrups. Expect long lines. Update: In November the shop is closed Mondays and Tuesdays (Oct–Jun schedule); the hours source is a 2021 article.

Name: Azuki to Kouri
Address (JA): 東京都渋谷区代々木1-46-2 グランデュオ代々木1F
Notes: Azuki and meringue kakigori with mochi sauce; seasonal flavors change about every two weeks. Update: Search shows the original shop in Minami-Shinjuku (opened autumn 2021, by a Florilege pastry chef) and a branch at Yoyogi Granduo; none confirmed in Yoyogi-Uehara. Sources place it at Yoyogi/Minami-Shinjuku (Yoyogi Grand Duo), not Yoyogi-Uehara; may be a different location than the planner assumed.

Name: Oribe
Address (JA): ~東京都世田谷区北沢二丁目
Notes: Inventive menu: hojicha milk, matcha with kinako warabi mochi, red bean, plus wild cards like an Indian-spiced "Namaste" ice. Update: Appears to be a tableware shop with a Japanese-sweets cafe space; kakigori is a summer-only item.

Name: Wa Kitchen Kanna
Address (JA): 東京都世田谷区下馬2-43-11 2F
Notes: Japanese-leaning flavors like "wakaba" (strawberry and matcha) plus experimental monthly specials. Update: Kakigori and Japanese set meals, opened 2013, serves kakigori year-round; about 12 min walk from Sangenjaya south exit near Setagaya Park. Daytime-only kakigori shop on Chazawa-dori; hours not found.

Name: Sabo Okuno Shibuya
Hours: 11:00–18:30 (last order); closed Tuesdays; seating by same-day or online numbered ticket
Address (JA): 東京都渋谷区神山町7-15 ホワイトハイム大嵩102
Notes: Experimental: coffee and hazelnut cream with coffee warabi mochi; even a savory avocado-salad ice. Update: Real name is 茶房 オクノシブヤ (Sabo Okuno Shibuya), in Kamiyamacho, Okushibuya, about 10 min from Shibuya Station.

Name: Asakusa Naniwaya
Address (JA): ~東京都台東区雷門二丁目
Notes: Cloud-soft ice with seasonal fruit and slow-simmered sauces; sweet potato sauce add-on. Handy for Asakusa days. Update: Branch of Naniwaya Sohonten, opened 2010, about 2 min from Asakusa Station (Tsukuba Express); taiyaki and year-round kakigori (about 10 kinds), tea room with eat-in. Search gave no address. Location approximate: pinned near 浅草 station until the shop is found.

Name: VIGO
Hours: Weekdays 13:00-23:00; Sat, Sun, holidays 11:00-23:00 (last order 22:15)
Address (JA): 東京都台東区蔵前4-21-2 FOCUS KURAMAE 1F
Notes: Night-parfait specialist with three seasonal parfaits: Uji matcha, yuzu sorbet, anko, salted kinako sable. One drink required per parfait. Update: Reported as in a hostel's ground-floor lounge, about 5 min walk from Kuramae Station. aumo lists later openings (15:00 weekdays, 13:00 weekends); sources disagree.

Name: Parfaiteria beL
Hours: Mon–Thu 17:00–24:00; Fri and eve of holidays 17:00–01:00; Sat 15:00–01:00; Sun and holidays 15:00–24:00; no regular closing day; last order 30 min before close
Address (JA): 東京都新宿区新宿3-8-2 クロスビル4F
Notes: From Sapporo's late-night "shime parfait" scene; artful parfaits with items like kuromame (black soybeans), burdock chips, tofu shiratama, Kaga bocha (roasted tea) jelly. Café-bar.

Name: Melon and Roman
Hours: 11:30–17:30 Wed–Sun; closed Mon and Tue (open if a holiday); café last order 16:30; closed year-end/New Year
Address (JA): 東京都新宿区神楽坂3-6-92
Notes: Melon specialist; Japanese muskmelon parfait with lemon granita. A take on Japan's fruit-parlor culture.

Name: Mr. CHEESECAKE
Hours: 8:00–22:00 Mon–Sat; 8:00–21:00 Sun and holidays; no regular closing day; takeout only
Address (JA): 東京都千代田区丸の内1-9-1 JR東京駅構内 B1F グランスタ東京 銀の鈴エリア
Notes: Cult brand's only permanent shop; France-trained chef; texture goes from rare (unbaked) to baked; seasonal flavors like maple pumpkin.

Name: CinqCinq
Hours: 10:30–18:00 daily (hours may change)
Address (JA): 東京都港区麻布十番2-4-8 麻布十番館 1F
Notes: Ten-flavor sampler cheesecake with Hokkaido dairy, incl. yuzu, sakura and dekopon (a Japanese citrus). Update: Official site lists no street address or hours; address and hours are from Tabelog.

Name: Johann
Hours: 10:00–18:30; closed days listed as none (third-party)
Address (JA): 東京都目黒区上目黒1-18-15
Notes: Same natural-ingredient recipe since 1978; simple, mellow cheesecake. Takeout only. Update: By the Meguro River, about a 3–4 min walk from Nakameguro Station (not Meguro Station).

Name: Shirotae
Hours: Tue–Fri 10:30–19:30; Sat 10:30–19:00; closed Sun and Mon
Address (JA): 東京都港区赤坂4-1-4
Notes: Old-school shop known for small, intense rare cheesecakes topped with pistachio, and for its cream puffs. Update: Cream puffs can be reserved up to the day before; closing times differ between sources (an older article says only Sun closed, open to 20:30).

Name: Pâtisserie TEN&
Hours: Takeaway 12:00–16:00 and 17:30–20:00; dine-in 12:00–15:30 and 17:30–19:30; open year-round
Address (JA): 東京都千代田区内幸町1-7-1 HIBIYA OKUROJI
Notes: Choux specialist; crisp shells filled with Uji matcha cream among other flavors. Update: Formerly Pâtisserie PAROLA (renamed April 2024); older listings show 11:30–22:00, which is out of date.

Name: Le Coussinet
Hours: Open Fri–Sun only; times not found
Address (JA): 東京都文京区根津2-34-24
Notes: Stone-oven cream puffs filled on the spot. Open Friday–Sunday only.

Name: Shirohige's Cream Puff Workshop
Hours: 10:30–18:00; closed Tuesdays (Wednesday if Tuesday is a holiday)
Address (JA): 東京都世田谷区代田5-3-1 1F
Notes: Officially licensed Totoro-shaped cream puffs with seasonal fillings; café upstairs at Daita. Update: The upstairs café (Toro Coffee & Bakery, 2F) is a separate business. Gnavi lists closing at 19:00 vs 18:00 on the official site; official used.

Name: I'm donut ?
Hours: Roughly 9:00–19:00 or until sold out; irregular closing days (listings disagree: 9–20, 11–20)
Address (JA): 東京都目黒区上目黒1-22-10
Notes: Ultra-soft brioche-like "nama" donuts from the team behind Amam Dacotan. Now has several branches; the original is in Nakameguro. Update: Takeout-only shop under the elevated tracks near the Nakameguro east exit.

Name: haritts
Hours: Mon–Fri 10:00–16:00; Sat and holidays 11:30–16:00; closed Sundays
Address (JA): 東京都渋谷区上原1-34-2
Notes: Soft, bread-like donuts in a homey café; highly rated (Tabelog 3.79). Update: Hours differ across sources (older articles show Wed–Fri 9:30–17:30, closed Mon/Tue); Retty's 2026 data used.

Name: Suzukien x Nanaya
Hours: 11:00–17:00; irregular closing days
Address (JA): 東京都台東区浅草3-4-3
Notes: Matcha gelato in seven intensities up to "Premium No. 7," from a tea merchant. Also hojicha and genmaicha. Update: Nanaya (Fujieda, Shizuoka) makes the matcha gelato served in this Suzukien shop.

Name: Japanese Ice Ouca
Hours: 11:00–23:00 daily (no fixed closing day); last order 23:00
Address (JA): 東京都渋谷区恵比寿1-6-7 animo ebisu 1F
Notes: Japanese-style ice cream with seasonal flavors like chestnut and sweet potato; topped with salted kombu. Update: The Kyoto branch listed on the official site is on Tominagacho, Shimogyo-ku, open only Sat/Sun/holidays 11:00–19:00, not Kawaramachi.

Name: Maison Farmer Nagisa Aoki
Hours: 12:00–20:00; closed Wednesdays plus irregular closures (check Instagram)
Address (JA): 東京都目黒区鷹番3-15-18 ル・コントゥ学芸大学102
Notes: Ingredient-led flavors from Japanese producers: fig leaf, hassaku citrus, sansho pepper milk. Update: The owner moved from Sangenjaya to Gakugei-daigaku.

Name: Kasiki
Address (JA): ~東京都渋谷区西原一丁目
Notes: Creative pairings like rhubarb with sansho pepper and green tea with rosemary.

Name: Tida
Address (JA): ~東京都杉並区高円寺南四丁目
Notes: Okinawan flavors: purple sweet potato, kokuto (black sugar) chocolate, Okinawan fruit. Update: Search gave no address; identity as the Koenji shop not confirmed. Location approximate: pinned near 高円寺 station until the shop is found.

Name: Chavaty
Hours: 10:00–20:00 daily; closed Jan 1
Address (JA): 東京都渋谷区神宮前4-6-9 南原宿ビル 1F
Notes: Tea specialist; hojicha soft serve using teas from different prefectures. Update: The official shop is named Omotesando (Minami-Harajuku Building, near Harajuku); it is the flagship. The hojicha soft serve was not confirmed on the menu page.

Name: Asakusa Chaya Tabane no Shi
Address (JA): ~東京都台東区浅草二丁目
Notes: Premium matcha crepe specialist using Shizuoka (Kakegawa) matcha. Also has a Kyoto branch on Shinkyogoku.

Name: Juseian
Hours: 11:00-17:30 (winter to 17:00); closes when sold out; irregular holidays
Address (JA): 東京都台東区浅草2-7-21
Notes: Chewy matcha crepes made with Kyoto Uji matcha. Update: Search matched the name 寿清庵 near Hanayashiki; address matched to the shop only by its hours, so verify.

Name: Natural Crepe
Hours: 11:00–20:00; closed days not stated
Address (JA): 東京都世田谷区経堂1-25-17 ルート経堂ビル
Notes: Domestic wheat and wheat-germ batter; additive-free anko and sesame sauce. Update: A chain with about ten shops; Kyodo is the original (eat-in available). Official site confirms domestic wheat, wheat germ and additive-free anko.

Name: Assemblages Kakimoto
Hours: Cafe 12:00–17:00 (last order), store 12:00–19:00; dinner from 18:00 by reservation only; closed Tuesdays and Wednesdays
Address (JA): 京都府京都市中京区竹屋町通寺町西入ル松本町587-5
Notes: Award-winning chocolatier using Japanese ingredients in chocolates and plated desserts; counter salon. Probably the best Kyoto fit. Update: Dinner service (from 18:00) is by reservation only; cafe/store hours are daytime only.

Name: PÂTISSERIE.S salon
Hours: 13:00–18:00 (last order 17:30); closed Wednesdays and Thursdays; may close early if cakes sell out
Address (JA): 京都府京都市中京区朝倉町546 ウェルスアーリ天保1F
Notes: One of Tabelog's top-ranked Kyoto cake shops (3.82); eat-in café branch. Update: Address is on Asakura-cho near Kyoto City Hall-mae, not on Teramachi itself. Tabelog shows 12:30 opening; official site says 13:00.

Name: PÂTISSERIE.S
Hours: 11:00–19:00 (last order 18:30); closed Wednesdays and Thursdays; may close early if cakes sell out
Address (JA): 京都府京都市下京区高辻通室町西入繁昌町300-1 カノン室町四条1F
Notes: Original takeaway shop of the same patisserie (3.78). Update: Takeaway only; the address is Takatsuji-Muromachi (a few minutes from Shijo-Karasuma).

Name: grains de vanille
Hours: 10:30–18:00 Monday–Saturday; closed Sundays and the 1st and 3rd Mondays (hours from Retty; official site says to check Instagram/Facebook)
Address (JA): 京都府京都市中京区間之町二条下ル鍵屋町486
Notes: Long-standing top French patisserie in Kyoto; refined petits gâteaux (3.78). Central and easy to fit in. Update: Name is written "grains de vanille" (グラン ヴァニーユ).

Name: La Voiture
Hours: Tuesday–Sunday 11:30–18:00 (last order 17:00); closed Mondays; another listing says 11:00–17:30
Address (JA): 京都府京都市左京区聖護院円頓美町47-5
Notes: Tiny shop making one famous family-recipe tarte tatin for decades (3.71). Pair with the Okazaki museums.

Name: Malebranche Kitayama Honten
Hours: Shop 9:00–17:30 daily; salon 10:00–17:30 (last order 17:00); no regular closing day
Address (JA): 京都府京都市北区北山通植物園北山門前
Notes: Kyoto institution behind the matcha "Cha no Ka" langue de chat; the main store has a full cake case.

Name: Le Petit Mec
Hours: 8:00–18:00 daily, no regular closing day
Address (JA): 京都府京都市上京区元北小路町159
Notes: Beloved Parisian-style bakery; go for croissants and viennoiserie.

Name: Shinshindo Kyodai Kitamonmae
Hours: 10:00–18:00 (last order 17:30); closed Tuesdays (some sources say opening at 8:00)
Address (JA): 京都府京都市左京区北白川追分町88
Notes: French bakery-café since the early 1900s; more for atmosphere than fusion. Update: Sources disagree on opening time (8:00 vs 10:00); Tabelog says 10:00.

Name: Gion Tokuya
Address (JA): 京都府京都市東山区祇園町南側570-127
Notes: Kyoto's best-known warabi mochi, from real bracken flour (honwarabi), served on ice; pour kuromitsu over the melting ice at the end. Expect a line. Update: Hours from Retty; ticket/phone-call queue system for the wait.

Name: Saryo Hosen
Hours: 10:00–17:00 (last order 16:45); closed Wednesdays and Thursdays (next weekday if a holiday)
Address (JA): 京都府京都市左京区下鴨西高木町25
Notes: Made to order and served in a tatami room overlooking a garden, with Okinawan black sugar syrup. Eat-in only. Pair with Shimogamo Shrine.

Name: Mitsuya
Hours: 10:00–19:00; Tabelog lists no closed day, a 2022 article says closed Wednesdays
Address (JA): 京都府京都市右京区西院高山寺町8
Notes: Natural Akita bracken flour for extra stretch; about six flavors incl. azuki with cacao nibs. Takeout only. Update: Opened Feb 2022 right by Hankyu Saiin Station.

Name: Ichijoji Nakaya
Hours: Shop 9:00–18:00, café 10:00–17:00 (last order); closed Wednesdays except open in late November; also closed around Obon and New Year
Address (JA): 京都府京都市左京区一乗寺花ノ木町5
Notes: Summer "zaru warabi" with fresh Hokkaido cream, kuromitsu and kinako (Japanese-Western mix). Also known for dechi yokan.

Name: Mamemono to Taiyaki
Hours: 10:00–17:00 daily, no fixed closing day
Address (JA): 京都府京都市右京区嵯峨天龍寺芒ノ馬場町40-8 嵐山昇龍苑1F
Notes: Round, thin-crust taiyaki with Kyoto anko or custard. Kyoto's top-rated taiyaki on Tabelog (3.51). Takeout only.

Name: Ichiwa (Ichimonjiya Wasuke)
Hours: 10:00–17:00; closed Wednesdays (open if Wednesday is the 1st/15th or a holiday, then closed next day); closed Dec 16–31 approx.
Address (JA): 京都府京都市北区紫野今宮町69
Notes: Open since about the year 1000. Thumb-sized mochi dusted in kinako, charcoal-grilled on bamboo skewers, served in white miso sauce. Daitokuji is 5 min away.

Name: Kazariya (Aburi Mochi Honke Nemoto Kazariya)
Hours: 10:00–17:00; closed Wednesdays; closed Dec 16–31
Address (JA): 京都府京都市北区紫野今宮町96
Notes: Edo-period rival serving the same dish; try both. The two close on different days of the week, so check before going. Update: Tabelog lists both Ichiwa and Kazariya as closed Wednesdays, contradicting the note that they close on different days.

Name: Kamo Mitarashi Chaya
Hours: 9:30–18:30 Mon, Thu–Sun; closed Tuesdays and Wednesdays (Tuesday closure irregular)
Address (JA): 京都府京都市左京区下鴨松ノ木町53
Notes: Said to be the birthplace of mitarashi dango (grilled, sweet soy glaze). Pair with Saryo Hosen.

Name: Demachi Futaba
Hours: 8:30–17:30 (Tuesdays 9:00–17:00); closed Wednesdays
Address (JA): 京都府京都市上京区出町通今出川上ル青龍町236
Notes: Top-rated on Tabelog; famous mame daifuku (mochi with salty black soybeans). Go in the morning to beat the line.

Name: Kawabata Doki
Hours: 9:30–17:30 Mon, Tue, Thu–Sun; closed Wednesdays; reservation only, no eating on premises
Address (JA): 京都府京都市左京区下鴨南野々神町2-12
Notes: Top-rated traditional wagashi maker on Tabelog. Update: Tabelog says reservations are required (takeaway sweets, no dine-in).

Name: Kyo no Koriya Sawa
Hours: Wednesday–Sunday 11:00–18:30; closed Mondays and Tuesdays (seasonal shop)
Address (JA): 京都府京都市上京区泰童片原町664-7
Notes: Known for unusual Kyoto white miso kakigori. Check if it's open off-season. Update: Tabelog name is Kyo no Koriya Sawa (Koriya, not Hyo-ya).

Name: Mikazuki Hyokaten
Hours: 11:00–18:00; closed Wednesdays
Address (JA): 京都府京都市東山区下新シ町329
Notes: Uji kintoki (matcha and azuki) with house-made milk ice cream.

Name: Gion Kinana Honten
Hours: 12:00–17:30; closed Thursdays
Address (JA): 京都府京都市東山区祇園町南側570-119
Notes: Kinako (roasted soybean) ice cream and kinako parfaits; Tabelog 3.68, one of Kyoto's top ice cream shops. Update: Cashless only; reservations via Instagram DM.

Name: Premarché Gelateria
Hours: Mon, Tue, Thu 12:00–18:00; Fri–Sun 12:00–20:00; closed Wednesdays
Address (JA): 京都府京都市中京区三条通猪熊西入御供町308
Notes: Rice-based flavors like "Mizuho no Kuni" rice gelato and roasted rice caramel; many vegan options.

Name: Tomomi Gelato
Hours: 13:00–20:00 Mon, Tue, Fri, Sun and holidays; Sat 13:00–22:00; closed Wednesdays and Thursdays
Address (JA): 京都府京都市下京区西橋詰町759 SAKIZO河原町五条ビル1F
Notes: Japanese produce: Setoda lemon, Gifu "Mino Musume" strawberry, salted sweet sake ("Kyohime").

Name: Hitsuji
Address (JA): ~京都府京都市中京区大炊町
Notes: Tabelog's #1 donut shop in Japan (3.85). Chunky natural-yeast donuts with kinako, wasanbon sugar, germinated brown rice. Sells out.

Name: koé donuts kyoto
